content: Root cause: The RAMDirectory class was not properly implementing serialization due to the use of non-serializable fields (fileNames and files) that were directly referencing the internal fileMap. This led to issues when attempting to serialize instances of RAMDirectory, as these fields were not being correctly managed during the serialization process. The patch resolves this by removing the direct references to these fields and instead creating them as local variables within methods, ensuring that the class remains serializable.
